title: He Alone Is The Lord's Servant, O
summary: The shabad does not leave ego at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed
lifeApplication: Notice where the self wants the line to confirm it instead of soften it. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: He alone is the Lord's servant, O Nanak, who is so blessed; working for Him, you shall obtain glorious greatness
